group.passage: Air pollution is not always easy to see, but it can still harm our health. One common way to measure it is PM2.5: tiny bits floating in the air that are 2.5 micrometers across or smaller. Breathing in fine particles like these is linked to heart and lung diseases. The chart below shows the yearly average amount of PM2.5 measured at one air-quality station in each of three cities: Taipei, Taichung, and Kaohsiung. As the chart shows, all three cities have made clear progress since 2015. That year, the station in Kaohsiung recorded an average of 25.8 micrograms per cubic meter, the highest of the three. By 2025, the number had fallen to 16.1. Taichung saw an even bigger drop, from 24.9 to 13.6. Taipei's air was the cleanest from the start, and its average dropped from 19.0 to around 12. What made the air cleaner? The government worked on several sources of pollution at the same time, from power plants to motorcycles. At the coal-fired Taichung Power Plant, four large boilers were upgraded by 2020, a change that was expected to cut the plant's air pollution by 80 percent within five years. Some state-run companies also replaced their coal-burning boilers with gas-burning ones. On the roads, owners of old, high-polluting motorcycles were offered rewards for giving them up. In the first eleven months of 2022 alone, 1.68 million of these motorcycles were taken off the roads. Not all of the change came from inside Taiwan, however. Weather and pollution from other countries also play a part. In 2022, for example, more rain fell in parts of Taiwan, and pollution blown over from China dropped by 20 to 30 percent. Even so, the environmental agency says that the steps taken at home cut local pollution by 82 percent, far more than the 60 percent it had planned.

2.strategy_zh: 先找題幹的 Taichung Power Plant，只看那一句；下一句的主詞換成 Some state-run companies，說的是別的單位。

translation_zh.text:
空氣污染並不總是容易看見，但它仍然可能傷害我們的健康。一種常見的測量方式是 PM2.5：飄浮在空氣中、直徑 2.5 微米以下的微小顆粒。吸入這類細懸浮微粒和心臟病、肺病有關。下面的圖表顯示三個城市——台北、台中和高雄——各一個空氣品質測站測得的 PM2.5 年平均值。
如圖所示，三個城市自 2015 年以來都有明顯進步。那一年，高雄的測站測得的平均值是每立方公尺 25.8 微克，是三個城市中最高的。到了 2025 年，這個數字已降到 16.1。台中下降得更多，從 24.9 降到 13.6。台北的空氣一開始就是最乾淨的，平均值從 19.0 降到 12 左右。
是什麼讓空氣變乾淨的？政府同時從好幾個污染來源下手，從發電廠到機車都有。燃煤的台中火力發電廠在 2020 年前完成四座大型鍋爐的改善，預計五年內讓電廠的空氣污染減少八成。一些國營事業也把燃煤鍋爐換成燃氣鍋爐。在道路上，老舊高污染機車的車主只要淘汰機車就能獲得獎勵。光是 2022 年的前十一個月，就有 168 萬輛這類機車退出道路。
然而，並非所有的改變都來自台灣內部。天氣和來自其他國家的污染也有影響。例如 2022 年，台灣部分地區雨量較多，而從中國飄來的污染減少了兩到三成。即便如此，環保主管機關表示，國內採取的措施讓本地污染減少了 82%，遠超過原本計畫的 60%。

problems: 第 4 題（chart_reading）的正解與資料不符：圖表只取奇數年，題目問高雄測站年平均「最高」的年份，正解 2017（26.7）；但事實單 d1（本輪另依環境部每日平均值重算確認）前金 2016 年是 28.67，比 2017 年的 26.67 高。折線在 2015 與 2017 之間畫成直線，正好藏住真正的最高點；圖的 description 說「2017 年是這條線的最高點，之後一路下降」，解析說「最高的是 2017 年」，學生會學到錯的結論（之後也不是一路下降：2021 年 21.14 高於 2020 年 20.19）。須改成逐年資料（2015–2025 全列）或改問圖上沒有被取樣藏住的資訊後重生。
第二段 “its average dropped from 19.0 to around 12” 與資料不符：台北中山測站 2025 年是 12.53（圖上 12.5），四捨五入到整數是 13；應寫 about 12.5，或改用 2023 年的 11.9。
